name: Shinoyama Tokiha
source:
Tokiha is a very quiet girl who doesn’t really talk to others very much. She’s very beautiful and almost doll-like. She is the only girl in some famous family and so is under some pressure from them. There are people who think that she is actually like a puppet (in the fact that she just goes along with people) but Rei thinks that this isn’t true.

[edited from [url=http://liemyx.wordpress.com/2011/05/31/preview-diamic-days/]Liemyx's blog[/url]]
